title: How do referees integrate evaluation criteria into their overall judgment? Evidence from grant peer review
reasoning: The paper discusses concepts like 'impartiality' and 'commensuration bias,' which have ethical implications related to fairness in peer review. However, its primary focus is on empirically analyzing how human referees integrate evaluation criteria into their judgments and comparing the predictive performance of different decision models (fast-and-frugal trees vs. logistic regression) for this process, rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical frameworks, morals, or religious concepts themselves.
